architecture.fixtures: Lake (county tax parcels), Osceola (county parcels), Orange (OCPA), Polk, Seminole (DOH geometry plus county land use), and Sumter (SWFWMD parcels) are complete 5.0–150.0 acre extracts in 0.25° tiles under data/fixtures/orlando-parcels/tiles/{fips}/. Parcels under 5 or over 150 are excluded. Brevard, Marion, and Volusia remain single-file samples.
architecture.runtime: GET /api/parcels?market=Orlando&bbox=w,s,e,n reads only tiles that intersect the viewport. Optional source=live queries DOH for a zoomed-in sample county at ≥5 acres. A live query for a complete county uses 217800 <= LND_SQFOOT <= 6534000.
architecture.acreageRule: Lake uses Open Data Acres. Osceola uses county TotalAcres. Sumter uses SWFWMD AREANO (ACRES is empty). Orange uses OCPA ACREAGE and sums multipart pieces that disagree. Polk and Seminole use 217800 <= FDOR LND_SQFOOT <= 6534000. Parcels outside 5.0–150.0 are excluded.

primaryStack.name: Florida DOH EHWATER parcels (FDOR NAL attributes)
primaryStack.notes: Still the live viewport and the Polk complete extract. Seminole fixtures keep DOH geometry and join county land use. Sumter fixtures use the SWFWMD parcel mirror. Lake and Osceola fixtures use the county layers below. Orange fixtures use OCPA.

fieldMapping.zoning: null on Polk DOH. Osceola Zoning/13, Lake InteractiveMap/50, Seminole Land_Use/1, and Sumter FLU_Zoning/11 are centroid-joined. St. Cloud, Altamonte Springs, and Oviedo override those county codes inside the city. Orange uses OCPA ZONING_CODE.
fieldMapping.flu: null on Polk DOH. Osceola Future_Land_Use/12, Lake InteractiveMap/48, Seminole Land_Use/0, Sumter FLU_Zoning/5, and Orange County + Orlando FLU are centroid-joined. St. Cloud, Altamonte Springs, and Oviedo override inside the city.

Income and AADT are not joined on the full extract.

gaps: Complete 5.0–150.0 acre extract from county Parcels FeatureServer/3. Taxable value is prior-roll PrevTaxabl. EstimatedT is an estimate. Q_U is stored and not used as a sale filter.

Zoning and FLU are centroid joins. Codes are not in the Orange knowledge base, so multifamily filters treat them as unknown. Directory HTML is often 403; JSON queries work. The host certificate chain is incomplete from some clients.
St. Cloud zoning and FLU override the county code on a matching PIN. They are not a county-wide extract. Winter Springs EnerGov is Seminole and is not used. Kissimmee city zoning remains a gap.
